P-01.texto: The thieves were mortal professionals, and the building's cameras were put on a loop. (Doc 10: the cameras were disconnected from 2:52 to 3:03.)

obtencion.como: Ezra's prelude: at 2:52 he sees a block of Gale Sentinel cameras in Ballard go dark for eleven minutes.
Intelligence + Technology (Difficulty 3): Helen's camera has a disconnection log from 2:52 to 3:03.

The thieves were mortal professionals and the cameras were looped. Intelligence + Investigation (Difficulty 3) when searching the apartment: they got in with an electronic lock pick and knew where to look (P-01, reinforced); with 3 or more successes, the adhesive repeater on the door frame.
DOC-01: the cameras that “didn't record anything” are the first sign of Gale Sentinel.
The dark lights on the Gale Sentinel cameras are P-01 and lead to A1-E05.

P-02.texto: There's a smell of someone else's Vitae on the doorknob: it belongs to a ghoul. (Doc 10: ghoul Vitae on the doorknob and in the hallway.)
P-02.nota: If the coterie takes Helen away right away, A1-E01 happens at the hangar, and P-02 is lost if it wasn't detected (doc 10).

obtencion.como: Resolve + Awareness (Difficulty 2), or automatic with Auspex 1: the coin smell in the hallway is watered-down Vitae, with no Beast behind it. Auspex 4 (Spirit's Touch) on the doorknob: the mark of a ghoul waiting for their next dose.
Smell of someone else's Vitae on the doorknob: it belongs to a ghoul (if it wasn't found earlier).
The one sniffing around the stairwell is a Gale ghoul (MEN-04). His Vitae is the P-02 trail.

P-03.texto: The blows that destroyed the minor Nosferatu at Pier 46 follow the doctrine of *Controlled Fury*.

obtencion.como: Intelligence + Brawl (Difficulty 4): dents at chest height, always in the same sequence (ribs, sternum, throat). David, with LOR-01 at level 4, recognizes it without rolling.
LOR-01 level 4 “The Complete Guard”: you recognize the doctrine the moment you see it.

efectos.efecto: Vote: Thornquist switches to “no” if the coterie proves to him that Krell, Halloway's man, destroyed Pike (P-03 plus P-12 or Krell's testimony).

P-04.nombre: Partial Copy of the File on a USB Drive
P-04.texto: On the body there's a USB drive with a partial copy of the File.
P-04.nota: It's USB drive 1 (folders 2014–2018, includes the Larchmont). If the coterie doesn't get it, it enters the chain of custody and Hale copies it on Night 3 (Thermometer +1). Montgomery confiscates it in A1-E03 if they show it to him, unless Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 3) (docs 10 and 11).

obtencion.como: Wits + Awareness (Difficulty 3): the USB drive is in the inside pocket of the jacket, among the ashes. Taking it without the officers seeing: Dexterity + Larceny (Difficulty 3).

P-05.texto: Thornquist confirms there are copies of the File on the market and that the courier is a thin-blood, Jun.

obtencion.como: Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4) with Thornquist: with one success he confirms there are copies for sale; with 3 or more, he reveals that Jun brought them to him and where she sleeps. Ezra gets +2 dice.

P-06.texto: The doorbell cameras in Helen's building are all Gale Sentinel. The company received a data request that doesn't appear in any log. (Doc 10: authorized by “P.G.”; partially in A1-E01, the Eastside IP.)

obtencion.como: Intelligence + Technology (Difficulty 4) on Helen's laptop: the cloud was wiped from an IP at an Eastside data center (P-06, partial).
Intelligence + Investigation (Difficulty 3): a request dated November 9, at 4:12, for access to the Market Street building's network, with no contract, authorized by “P.G.”
If A1-E05 is skipped, the same information turns up in A3-E02.
DOC-05: the November 9 message (“Change the lock”). It was Gale Sentinel (P-06).

P-07.nombre: Halloway Knows About the Cold Water
P-07.texto: Halloway mentions Vance with a detail he shouldn't know. (Doc 11: Halloway knows about the cold-water business.)

nombres.11: Halloway Knows About the Cold Water
nombres.13: P-07 · Halloway Knows About the Cold Water
nombres.01: Halloway Knows Too Much About Vance

obtencion.como: Intelligence + Academics (Difficulty 3), or automatic for David: Halloway quotes “the cold water in the mornings,” which appears only in Vance's private journals. Wits + Insight (Difficulty 4) to notice he's lying when he explains it.

efectos.efecto: Winning over the assembly at Salt's: the Difficulty drops by 1 for each clue the coterie brings (P-08 or P-07).

dados.texto: +1 die to the central Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4) test to convince Montgomery
+1 die to the case test at the Council

P-08.texto: An Intelligence + Brawl (Difficulty 4) test reveals that the technique is wrong: Krell strikes with the inverted guard, the way Vance taught the students who never finished their training. (Doc 10: hint in A1-E02.)

obtencion.como: With 4 or more successes on Intelligence + Brawl, or LOR-01 at level 4 and one success on Wits + Brawl (Difficulty 3): the last blow came in from the left, as if the attacker's guard were switched. Teo: “He hit with his left out front, like southpaws in boxing.”
Intelligence + Brawl (Difficulty 4) on Corwin's ashes: Controlled Fury with the inverted guard, weak hand forward. David, with LOR-01 at level 4: automatic.
If the coterie arrives in time, David automatically recognizes the inverted guard with LOR-01 at level 4.
DOC-04: the doctrine of Controlled Fury and the inverted guard, which gives Krell away (P-08).
LOR-01 level 4 “The Complete Guard”: you recognize the doctrine the moment you see it (P-03, P-08).

efectos.efecto: Winning over the assembly at Salt's: the Difficulty drops by 1 for each clue the coterie brings (P-08 or P-07).

dados.texto: +1 die to the central Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4) test to convince Montgomery
+1 die to the case test at the Council

P-09.texto: O'Connor reveals that Vance's journals weren't burned: in 1986 they were sold to “a Seattle Ventrue with patience.”

obtencion.como: After the three rounds in the ring, O'Connor tells them about the 1986 shipment from Lyon, addressed to one of Halloway's companies: handwritten journals with “M.V.” on the cover.

dados.texto: +1 die to the central Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4) test to convince Montgomery
+1 die to the case test at the Council

P-10.texto: The log of shipments to “SEA-0411” at the Gale Sentinel data center.

obtencion.como: Layer 3, storage: the shipping logs from the ARCHER channel, with reference SEA-0411, and the complete DOC-07.
DOC-07 can arrive earlier if Voight trusts the coterie.

efectos.efecto: Vote: Voight switches to “no” if the coterie proves to her that ARCHER is Halloway (P-10, the C.H. email, or Gale's or Dawson's testimony).

dados.texto: +1 die to the central Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4) test to convince Montgomery
+2 dice to the case test at the Council (proves Halloway is ARCHER)

P-11.texto: The digital signature of Preston Gale, Halloway's ghoul.
P-11.nota: COT-02 · The Glass Council: the coterie shouldn't know it exists until A3-E02, when they find Gale's signature (doc 08).

variantes.10: Celeste's prelude (A0-E01) called the payment to the crew of thieves “P-11 early.” Doc 11 assigns that payment to P-14 (“the one Celeste signed in her prelude”); doc 11 wins.

obtencion.como: Layer 2, Gale's office: Intelligence + Investigation (Difficulty 3); one success: Preston Gale's digital signature on the access authorizations for Market Street.

dados.texto: +1 die to the central Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4) test to convince Montgomery
+1 die to the case test at the Council

P-12.texto: Krell's testimony, if he agrees to be a witness against Halloway.
P-12.nota: Doc 07 (PNJ-12): if the coterie shows him the folios Halloway promised him, Krell switches sides (P-12).

obtencion.como: With Krell at 3 “steps,” the “Witness” offer: Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 3); Krell accepts if David promises him nobody will destroy him afterward. The “The Other Guard” offer (LOR-01 at level 4 and P-15, or folio 42) also turns him into a witness, no roll needed.

efectos.efecto: Krell present as a witness: +2 more dice to the central test.
Vote: Thornquist switches to “no” with P-03 plus P-12 or Krell's testimony. If Krell testifies, Halloway loses his composure for the first time.

dados.texto: +1 die to the central Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4) test to convince Montgomery
+3 dice to the case test at the Council (Krell as a witness)

nombres.13: P-13 and P-14 · Sal's Ledger and the Cascade Payment

obtencion.como: Doc 11 erratum: Thornquist says the copies come from a fence in SoDo; the fence's name is worth a minor favor (P-13, partial).
Wits + Investigation (Difficulty 3): the ledger is under the desk. Entry for November 13: “L.B. — 3 keys, 2 sold (T.), 1 pending. Motel?”

dados.texto: +1 die to the central Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4) test to convince Montgomery
+1 die to the case test at the Council, together with P-14 (the two count as a single die)

P-14.texto: The payment to Lonnie, made from Cascade Holdings LLC, a Halloway Meridian company (the one Celeste signed in her prelude).
P-14.nota: If the coterie uses Dominate on Lonnie to make him forget, P-14 is lost unless they question him first (doc 11).

nombres.11: The Payment to Lonnie, Made from Cascade Holdings LLC / Payment from Cascade Holdings
nombres.13: P-13 and P-14 · Sal's Ledger and the Cascade Payment

obtencion.como: Celeste's prelude: at 3:30 she authorizes “an urgent payment to a security vendor” from a Halloway Meridian company. If she reviews the transfer later, it's an early clue.
obtencion.nota: Doc 10 called it “P-11 early”; doc 11 defines P-14 as the payment “from Cascade Holdings LLC… the one Celeste signed in her prelude,” and doc 13 mentions “P-14 and the note from the prelude.” The newest doc wins.

obtencion.como: If Celeste reviews the Cascade accounts that same week (Halloway's trap), she finds P-14 earlier.
Lonnie: “The money came from a company. Cascade Holdings. I've got the receipt.”
Layer 2, Gale's office: the records of the payments to Lonnie from Cascade Holdings, if they don't already have them.

efectos.efecto: Celeste defends herself with the truth: if she found P-14 and the note from the prelude, she proves she only signed what Pell handed her: +2 dice to the case test.

dados.texto: +1 die to the central Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4) test to convince Montgomery
+1 die to the case test at the Council, together with P-13 (the two count as a single die)

P-15.texto: Folios 41 and 42 of Vance's journal about “the German,” with Pell's note and Halloway's reply (“No. — C.H.”).
P-15.nota: GAN-07: copy 3 of the journals, held by the Justicar, has folios that aren't in the other two, including the ones that talk about Krell (doc 09).
P-15.ayuda: Given out as a handout: two folios from Vance's journal (Marseille, 1976), in French, with Pell's typewritten translation (doc 12).

obtencion.como: Layer 3, private archive (air-gapped server): copying the files takes Intelligence + Technology (Difficulty 3); finding the folios among thousands of images takes Intelligence + Investigation (Difficulty 4), or it's automatic by searching for the word “allemand.”

efectos.efecto: Showing P-15 to Krell adds 3 “steps” at once. The “The Other Guard” offer requires LOR-01 at level 4 and P-15 (or David knowing folio 42).
Spotting the forgery of the “M.V.” letter is automatic with P-15 or DOC-04. If the coterie already showed P-15 or the C.H. email to Montgomery, the scene skips its first half.

dados.texto: +1 die to the central Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4) test to convince Montgomery
+1 die to the case test at the Council (and the “No. — C.H.” note)

PRUEBA-CORREO-CH.como: Layer 2, Gale's office: three or more successes on Intelligence + Investigation (Difficulty 3). “Recover all copies. Top priority. — C.H.,” dated November 13.

efectos.efecto: If they already showed it to Montgomery, the scene skips its first half.
Vote: Marchetti switches to “no” if she sees DOC-08, with Whitmore's note (“C.H. — watch”). Keeping the promise to O'Connor makes him Allies 2.
Vote: Marchetti switches to “no” if the coterie cites her Night 3 record: the record is what she respects most.

PRUEBA-TESTIGO-GALE.como: Dawson alive and captured is a witness: Gale's ghoul, he sniffed out Helen's stairwell and received the drive from Lonnie (doc 12).

efectos.efecto: Vote: Voight switches to “no” with Gale's or Dawson's testimony.

PRUEBA-MONTGOMERY.como: Success with 3 or more successes on the central test in A3-E04: Montgomery enters the Council alongside David.

PRUEBA-DISCO-ORIGINAL.nombre: The Original Drive in the Coterie's Hands
PRUEBA-DISCO-ORIGINAL.como: It's only in Gale's data center until Night 6.

efectos.efecto: Halloway can't use it as evidence against the Prince.
Halloway finds out on Night 7 and speeds up the leak to FIRSTLIGHT: Thermometer +1.

PRUEBA-FAVOR-MONTGOMERY.nombre: Montgomery owes the coterie a favor (Krell handed over to the Sheriff in A3-E03)

PRUEBA-MENTIRA-A1-E03.nombre: The coterie lied to Montgomery in A1-E03 and he wrote it down

PRUEBA-HONESTIDAD-DAVID.nombre: David admits something that costs him (what he knows about Krell, what he felt in the silos, the Larchmont business)

PRUEBA-HERMANO-DE-SANGRE.nombre: “He's my blood brother” (if David knows it and says so)

PRUEBA-FALSIFICACION.como: Intelligence + Academics (Difficulty 3), or automatic with DOC-04 or P-15: it's in English (Vance wrote in French) and has traces of toner.

PRUEBA-INFORMES-HAL.nombre: Hal says that in thirty years of reports he never found anything that cast doubt on David

PRUEBA-CELESTE-VERDAD.nombre: Celeste defends herself with the truth (P-14 and the note from the prelude)

PRUEBA-NADIA-PRINCIPE.nombre: Nadia speaks on behalf of the Prince (Charisma + Performance instead of Politics)

valores.texto: +2 dice to the case test if it succeeds

PRUEBA-ASHBY.nombre: Julian Ashby testifies against Halloway (Charisma + Persuasion, Difficulty 2, if he's accused at the Council)

PRUEBA-OKAFOR-LONNIE.nombre: FIRSTLIGHT has Lonnie: Okafor has a witness who talks about Cascade Holdings
PRUEBA-OKAFOR-LONNIE.como: “If the coterie finds out about this later, they can use it in A4-E01.” The doc doesn't set its value.

A3-E04.nombre: The Pack Hesitates: The Central Test
A3-E04.tirada: Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4), rolled by whoever speaks for the coterie
A3-E04.automatico: If anyone attempts Dominate or Presence on Montgomery (Fortitude 4, Unswayable Mind), he notices and the central test automatically fails.
A3-E04.nota: Doc 12 wins: +1 die for each clue from P-07 to P-15.

variantes.01: Manipulation + Persuasion, Difficulty 4, +1 die for each clue P-07 to P-12.

resultados.efecto: The Wolves (COT-01) are with the coterie: Montgomery enters the Council alongside David; during the raid, the bounty hunters help evacuate; in A4-E03, Montgomery waits on the dock.
Montgomery doesn't turn against them, but he doesn't help openly either: “Prove it to me tomorrow in front of everyone.”
The coterie are fugitives. The bounty hunters are hunting David. In A4-E01, David needs to get into the Council without being stopped at the door.

A4-E01.tirada: Manipulation or Charisma + Politics (Difficulty 4), contested by Halloway (Manipulation + Politics: 10 dice)

resultados.efecto: The room believes him. Celeste is handed over. The votes lean toward the regency.
Halloway is exposed. The vote almost certainly turns against him.
Total exposure. The Prince orders the Sheriff to arrest Halloway on the spot. Halloway flees (A4-E03).

valores.efecto: Halloway can't use it as evidence against the Prince

otros.motivo: The Council moves to the Glass Gallery (the Prince has regained the initiative)

votacion.porDefecto: If the coterie does nothing, Halloway wins 3 to 0, with two abstentions or Fry voting against.
votacion.automatico: Attacking Halloway in his tower: the vote comes out “yes” automatically. Using Dominate on a Primogen and getting caught (Voight's Wits + Awareness: 7 dice): that Primogen's vote turns against whoever tried it.

primogenitos.cambia: The coterie proves to her that ARCHER is Halloway (P-10, the C.H. email, or Gale's or Dawson's testimony).
The coterie proves to him that Krell destroyed Pike (P-03 plus P-12 or Krell's testimony), or offers him a major favor from the whole coterie.
She sees DOC-08, with Whitmore's note (“C.H. — watch”), or the coterie cites her Night 3 record (DOC-03). Then she votes “no.”

primogenitos.defecto: Unpredictable: roll 1 die; even, yes; odd, no.
primogenitos.cambia: Someone speaks a hard truth out loud during the debate: Fry votes with whoever said it.
